paper.title: Transformer Wave Function for two dimensional frustrated magnets: emergence of a Spin-Liquid Phase in the Shastry-Sutherland Model
paper.authors: Luciano Loris Viteritti, Riccardo Rende, Alberto Parola, Sebastian Goldt, Federico Becca

results.system_description: Shastry–Sutherland, 6 × 6 · J/J′ = 0.8 · periodic · Sz = 0. H = J sum_<ij> S_i · S_j + J' sum_dimers S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators S = sigma/2; J' = 1; J = 0.8; no constant shift
results.variant: Factored attention, 2 layers (h = 12, d = 72), point-group symmetrized
results.source_location: Appendix 'Extrapolations details', Table table:energies (main.tex l.682-698), row L = 6 (l.686), column '2 layers'
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy per site, in units of J', of the symmetrized ViT state at J/J' = 0.8 (Table table:energies); the 'Extrap.' column, a variance extrapolation to infinitely many layers, is not an entry.
results.notes: The caption of table:energies states: 'The Monte Carlo error due to finite sampling effects is on the last digit.' Recorded as one unit in the last printed digit, with its meaning unspecified (decision P1 of 2026-11-02). S = 1/2 operators on the L x L square lattice with periodic boundaries (Eq. SS_hamiltonian); all ground-state calculations are at Sz = 0 (Sec. Results). The ViT state is summed over the point group of the empty plaquette, C4 rotations and the diagonal reflection (Eq. symm_psi, appendix 'Lattice and symmetries'). The paper puts an empty plaquette at the origin; its dimer pattern is that of the instance translated by one lattice spacing. Factored multi-head attention with h = 12 heads and embedding dimension d = 72 (Sec. Benchmarks), n_l = 2 layers. Above the exact energy -0.4517531 given in the same caption.
